svg.text: A mobile app for reading and memorizing the Quran. It renders
real Mushaf pages from the original glyph fonts, so every page
matches the printed copy. I'm building both the React Native app
and the Node.js API behind it.
Four Mushaf layouts: KFGQPC V4, V2 and IndoPak 15 and 16 line
Made for memorization as well as daily reading
Translations, tafsir, word by word meanings and audio
Quranic text and data taken only from verified sources
